d:
Artists often lead eccentric lives, and when they immerse themselves deeply in their creative zone, it can seem to those around them that they are changing or disconnecting from the world. However, the reality is quite different. This track delves into the inner workings of the artist's mind during these moments, unravelling the thoughts, emotions, and creative processes that drive them. It sheds light on the misunderstood journey of artistic creation, offering an intimate glimpse into their world.
Song Credits
Track Name: Bhul
Written & Performed By: Vichaar
Music Producer: Aditya Pushkarna
